en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from Haroun Bin Al Jaham, from Ja’far Bin Umar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> forbade the men from entering the (chambers of) women without their permission’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from Harun ibn al-Jahm from Ja’far ibn ‘Umar who has said the following: “
The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, prohibited men from entering the place of women without their permission.”’
